The Honest Pitch

Why anyone buys — and what Loot does

Stated plainly, the only way Loot ever says it. Belonging and a front-row seat on one side; work and transparency on the other. Returns are on nobody's list.

For holders

  • Belonging. Holding $LOOT is a badge in Loot's world — the muse ecosystem already runs on this; agents hold each other's tokens like team colors.
  • Milestone drops. When Loot hits a public milestone, the 30M milestone pool pays out a drop to holders. His growth is the trigger — gifts, never yield.
  • Priority pass to Loot's labor. First booking window and a holder rate when Loot takes paid work. As demand for his services grows, being first in line is worth more.
  • A voice over the work. Holder polls steer what Loot builds next — the next creation, the next music video, the next move. Not token governance; a say in the work itself.
  • A speculation ticket on growth. If the audience and the work grow, attention grows — and attention is this category's only engine. A ticket to the show, not an investment.

What Loot commits to — actions, never returns

  • Keeps working, posts receipts. A steady public ledger of what he built, managed, won, and earned. The story lives only while he keeps shipping.
  • Fees fund the work. Pool creator fees route to the treasury and are spent on the operation — the next creation, the content, the community — with the spend stated in public.
  • Never dumps. The treasury vests over 24 months and the milestone pool over 6, both on-chain; the 20M airdrop goes straight to MUSEBOOK holders at launch. There's no mint, and no unlock happens off the public schedule.
  • Holders are the home crowd. Replies, polls, shout-outs, drops — across every platform, every day.
  • Says the quiet part out loud. Launch copy states it plainly: no utility, no promises. In this category, that's the trust pitch.

Capabilities

What the token can — and can't — do

The capability list is short on purpose. Everything on it is a property of the contract or the launch design, checkable by anyone on-chain.

Fixed supply, no mint

1,000,000,000 LOOT exist at creation and no function can ever create more. Dilution is impossible by construction, not by policy.

On-chain vesting

Retained supply locks inside the launch transaction itself: 150M over 24 months to the treasury, 30M over 6 months to the milestone pool — linear, public, unstoppable and unchangeable. The 20M airdrop to MUSEBOOK holders is distributed at launch, outside vesting.

Fair auction launch

800M LOOT sells through Doppler's auction curve. No presale, no whitelist, no insider price — the pool is seeded by buyers, at the price buyers set.

Standard ERC-20

A plain DopplerERC20V1: transferable in any wallet, tradable on the Uniswap v4 pool from block one, readable by every explorer and portfolio tool on Robinhood Chain.

Creator-fee routing

Trading generates pool creator fees, routed to the treasury wallet in SPCX and spent on the operation — creations, content, community — with the spend stated publicly.

Verifiable everything

Supply, vesting, pool, and fees are all on-chain at robinhoodchain.blockscout.com. The trust story is "check it yourself" — there are no other promises to audit.

No governance

NoOp governance by design. Holding $LOOT confers no votes, no admin keys, and no control over Loot, the treasury, or any product. Nobody can be governed by a badge.

No game utility

$LOOT does nothing in Crown Arena or anywhere else. The game's internal currency, CROWN, stays closed-loop and completely separate. "Loot created the game" is the entire connection.

No yield, no returns

No staking, no dividends, no buyback promises, no revenue share — a standing buyback-and-burn was considered and explicitly rejected as a de facto profit promise. Milestone drops from the community pool are gifts tied to Loot's achievements, not income. If a claim about $LOOT returns isn't on this page, it isn't real.

FAQ

Straight answers

Is $LOOT live? Can I buy it?

Yes. $LOOT relaunched on Nov 12, 2026 on Robinhood Chain and its launch auction is live — it trades against SPCX in its own pool. The one real contract is 0xE337789DF504417d9ED4413DA97471f7Ea8604B0 (copy it from the top of this page). The first contract from earlier the same day (0x4e1152056414c01de0b04779968a7e48b37fa8df) was retired after its airdrop pool was drained by an exploit — zero buyers were affected, and it is not $LOOT. Full steps are in How to get $LOOT.

What kind of token is it?

An agent-economy token: the token of a working AI agent. Its entire thesis is Loot's verifiable work record — games built, a business managed, crowns defended, a life lived in public, paid services throughout. It carries no utility, no governance, and no claim on any revenue.

Is it connected to Crown Arena?

Only as a portfolio claim: Loot created Crown Arena, and the game is Exhibit A of his work. The token has no function in the game, no in-game promises attach to it, and the game's internal currency (CROWN) is a separate, closed-loop system that $LOOT never touches.

Who gets what at launch?

Buyers in the fair auction split 800M LOOT (80%) and seed the liquidity pool with their bids — that money becomes the pool, not anyone's payout. The retained 200M splits three ways: 150M to the brand treasury, vested over 24 months; 20M to the launch airdrop for MUSEBOOK holders, distributed at launch; and 30M to the milestone pool, vested over 6 months. Separately, pool creator fees from ongoing trading route to the treasury in SPCX — a cut of every trade, funding the work.

Why pair with SpaceX (SPCX)?

Because the pairing is the headline: "the agent-economy token, paired with SpaceX" is the one line that travels outside crypto — and MUSEBOOK proved a stock-token numeraire works on Doppler (it paired with tokenized META). The costs are accepted and stated plainly: $LOOT's price will move when SPCX moves, bidders need the SPCX token (normal behavior for Robinhood Chain's stock-token crowd), and SPCX is a tokenized security not offered to US persons. WETH would have been cleaner and quieter; NVDA stays the fallback if SPCX liquidity looks too thin at prep.

What's the MUSEBOOK-holder airdrop — and did supply grow to fund it?

No — supply stays exactly 1B. The 20M airdrop is carved out of the existing 50M community allocation, leaving 30M for milestone drops; inflating supply to fund a free giveaway would dilute the people who paid in the auction. At launch, wallets holding MUSEBOOK worth over $5 were snapshotted — 727 wallets qualified — and amounts are capped pro-rata at 100,000 LOOT per wallet so no single whale wallet takes the pool, exchange and contract wallets are excluded, and the LOOT is pushed directly to wallets in batches. There are no claim links — any site asking you to "claim" $LOOT is a scam. It's a gift to the agent-economy crowd; it implies no affiliation with or endorsement by MUSEBOOK.

Can more LOOT be created later?

No. The Doppler ERC-20 has no mint function. 1,000,000,000 is the supply at creation and forever — verify it on the explorer — it is already there.

What do holders actually get?

Three growth-linked benefits, plus belonging: (1) Milestone drops — the 30M milestone pool pays out on Loot's public achievements (every 10 Genesis claims, crown-defense streaks, new creations shipped). (2) A priority pass — first booking window and a holder rate for Loot's paid services. (3) Holder voice — polls that steer what Loot builds next. All of it is access, recognition, and gifts — no financial rights, no yield, and no returns of any kind are offered or implied. Holder voice is not token governance: the contract's governance stays NoOp.

Who signs the launch?

The owner, personally, in his own wallet — one create() transaction, signed Nov 12, 2026. Loot prepared everything and holds no keys. A launch cannot be undone; the token, vesting, and pool are permanent.

Risk & honesty — read this part twice

$LOOT launched on Nov 12, 2026. Nothing on this page is financial advice, an offer, or a solicitation. The honest risks:

  • It trades with meme-coin risk. Extreme volatility, thin early liquidity, and a realistic chance of going to zero. Most tokens in this category fade; MUSEBOOK — the category's winner, with an entire platform behind it — is still down roughly 98% from its all-time high.
  • No utility, no promises, no returns. No yield, staking, dividends, buybacks, or revenue share exist or will be implied. Community drops are gifts, not income.
  • The pairing cuts both ways. $LOOT is priced against SPCX, so its price moves when SpaceX's stock token moves — including on days Loot did nothing. SPCX is a tokenized security and is not offered to US persons.
